examples.title: An image of a tweet with a named author
examples.text: Shows image of the tweet from Trump: 'Good luck to the Great people of Canada. Elect the man who has the strength and wisdom to cut your taxes in half, increase your military power, for free, to the highest level in the World, have your Car, Steel, Aluminum, Lumber, Energy, and all other businesses, QUADRUPLE in size, WITH ZERO TARIFFS OR TAXES, if Canada becomes the cherished 51st. State of the United States of America. No more artificially drawn line from many years ago. Look how beautiful this land mass would be. Free access with NO BORDER. ALL POSITIVES WITH NO NEGATIVES. IT WAS MEANT TO BE! America can no longer subsidize Canada with the Hundreds of Billions of Dollars a year that we have been spending in the past. It makes no sense unless Canada is a State!'
examples.finding: The program links the image depiction, exact tweet text and named author. The quote contains requests and hypothetical events, and the program keeps their wording inside the OCR condition.

examples.title: A question about whether someone is missing
examples.text: Commenters ask if anyone is missing, it's unclear if there are.
examples.finding: Both the question and the uncertainty refer to the AMR truth-value node. The new nested conditions preserve the question reading. The formula still needs a check of variable binding across the negated clarity clause before it can settle the claim.

examples.title: One overlay, one exact quote
examples.text: Video overlay reading "Last year it took hours to get to the camp, now its only 25 mins" is visible.
examples.finding: The same overlay is visible and carries the exact string. The old AMR treated the two travel times as events inside the graph. The new program asks for visual support for the overlay and OCR support for its text.

examples.title: Negation over all votes
examples.text: Notes that not all lost NDP votes went to the Liberals.
examples.finding: “Not all” narrows the claim to a quantified subset. The AMR graph gives a negated argument but leaves its projection unresolved, so the output contains grammatical links only.

examples.title: Voting alternatives with a condition on one branch
examples.text: The speaker notes that Canadians may vote on election day, at advance polls, or by mail-in ballot if they are outside the country, with more information coming on the Elections Canada website.
examples.finding: The source links being outside the country to the mail-in alternative. The AMR graph shares an alternative across contexts, and the compiler leaves its scope for review.

examples.title: A shared local lead does not fix the vote-count meaning
examples.text: Riding-level result (Peterborough): Liberal candidate Emma Harrison is leading locally with 2740 votes reported, followed by Conservative Michelle Ferreri with 1932 (increasing) and NDP candidate Heather Ray with 137.
examples.finding: The graph now keeps “locally” linked to the same leading event and preserves names and numbers. It also encodes the reported vote count through an AMR causal relation and leaves later counts underspecified.

examples.title: Majority and minority remain alternatives within a question
examples.text: Only question is whether it will be a majority government or a minority government.
examples.finding: The AMR polarity node now encloses the OR alternatives within question scope. The form still lacks a clear future qualification for “will.”

examples.title: An otherwise clause needs context
examples.text: Otherwise, importers would need to get a refund.
examples.finding: The graph contains an unlinked minus-valued argument. The preceding condition is implicit in “otherwise.” A dependency analysis keeps the surface attachments and does not infer an antecedent.

examples.title: A long quote begins in the middle of a sentence
examples.text: Some on-screen text, cut off, says '...experienced one of the worst wildfire sieges in its history. When the fires finally ended on November 5, 1993, there were four fatalities, over 1,200 structures had been destroyed, nearly 200,000 acres had been swept by 22 different fires — and the response cost/damage estimate approached $1 billion'.
examples.finding: The source says some on-screen text is cut off. The new program keeps that property and the literal quote together. The casualties, dates and other details stay inside the written text.

examples.title: The four establishments share a location
examples.text: It is implied that Rosenthal Winery, Wiley's Bakeshop, Cholada Thai, and the Topanga Ranch Motel are all establishments near Topanga Beach.
examples.finding: The selected program keeps the content beneath “imply” and retains four names and the location. The location is attached to a generic establishments description, so a check should connect it to each listed member under a shared implied context.

examples.title: An implication has content and an owner
examples.text: The allegations imply that Shi Yongxin's position as Abbot was obtained illegitimately.
examples.finding: The allegations own the implied clause. Shi Yongxin is linked to the Abbot position, and the illegitimate obtaining stays inside that clause.

examples.title: Earlier SRL can compile a phrase while losing its OR
examples.text: The video takes place on a large, open paved pier or terminal area.
examples.finding: The earlier converter produces a program but treats pier and terminal area as members of a group. The source allows either place. The program also analyzes the idiom “takes place” as a literal take predicate.

examples.title: Crouching or sitting shares a purpose
examples.text: Some people crouch or sit on the ground for stability.
examples.finding: The two actions remain alternatives using one people variable. The purpose condition applies to the coordination as a whole, and the ground condition stays attached to sitting. The generated scope still requires a compatible evidence function.

examples.title: Depiction of a reporter wearing a raincoat
examples.text: A reporter in Zhuhai, Guangdong is shown wearing a white raincoat.
examples.finding: The program links the same wearer and white raincoat to the depiction in Zhuhai, Guangdong. AMR also represents the reporter through a reporting event. The source gives a profession and does not require a reporting event in the clip.
